discriminative_prediction.aggregation: mean per-example absolute margin damage over all eligible origin-blind examples
discriminative_prediction.comparison: learned top-one removal versus deterministic same-cardinality control removal selected by SHA256(seed,user_id,positive_item_id) from non-top supports
discriminative_prediction.contradiction_rule: control damage is at least learned damage plus discriminative_relative_damage_margin times max(learned damage, finite_nonzero_floor)
discriminative_prediction.prediction: removing the learned highest-weight support causes more absolute pairwise-margin damage than removing one same-cardinality uniformly selected non-top support
discriminative_prediction.support_rule: learned damage is at least control damage plus discriminative_relative_damage_margin times max(control damage, finite_nonzero_floor)

required: record raw support logits and normalized support weights across all eligible probe users
support-weight saturation rate is no greater than maximum_support_saturation_rate
at least two users have distinct centered support-logit signatures
full and mechanism-off total losses are finite
stability contribution is finite and greater than finite_nonzero_floor
full versus mechanism-off loss absolute delta is greater than routing_score_or_margin_delta_floor
every declared mechanism parameter has a finite gradient with L2 norm greater than mechanism_gradient_l2_floor

mechanism_off_parent_equivalence.pass_rule: every finite maximum absolute delta is at most parent_equivalence_atol plus parent_equivalence_rtol times the reference maximum absolute value

required: under identical weights and inputs, toggling only the declared mechanism changes positive score or pairwise margin above routing_score_or_margin_delta_floor
the changed path is traced through support_gate and the history summary, not ordinary stochastic forward variation
record whether declared LightGCN propagation is actually present in the candidate active and off paths
for the same user and two distinct positive targets, compare the common support set
centered logits or pairwise support ordering on the common support set changes above activation_std_floor
a denominator-only softmax rescaling after excluding a target does not count as target-conditioned selection

declared_mechanism.claim: learned support selector plus counterfactual support-ablation stability objective
declared_mechanism.mechanism_off_definition: same declared parent/backbone and weights with learned support selection and the stability term disabled

full_ablation_gate.allowed_only_if: cheap state is ACTIVE_SUPPORTED or ACTIVE_CONTRADICTED, all identifiability probes pass, and resource feasibility is not RESOURCE_DEFERRED
full_ablation_gate.otherwise: stop after emitting the Q2 canonical receipt and Q3 package

derivation.discriminative_relative_damage_margin: five percent of the matched random-removal absolute damage, frozen as a direction-identification margin rather than a recommendation-metric PASS threshold
derivation.parent_equivalence_atol: existing Q1 parent-preserving unit-check maximum absolute tolerance
derivation.parent_equivalence_rtol: float32 same-weight same-input comparison tolerance; Q1 observed exact zero
derivation.participation_and_activation_floors: strictly above float32 numerical noise without defining an effect-size claim

probe_population.origin_blind_selection_rule: first, midpoint, and last batch of the frozen Q0R2 32-batch training prefix; within each batch take at most 32 structurally eligible examples in ascending (user_id,positive_item_id,negative_item_id) order with no outcome-based filtering

telemetry: train and eval peak allocated MiB
train and eval peak reserved MiB

precedence: NOT_ASSESSED when required physical evidence has not run
INACTIVE when loss participation, mechanism gradients, gate activation, or traced routing fails
NON_IDENTIFIABLE when declared-parent equivalence, target conditioning, fairness, or discriminative separation fails
ACTIVE_SUPPORTED when participation and identifiability pass and the preregistered discriminative support rule passes
ACTIVE_CONTRADICTED when participation and identifiability pass and the preregistered contradiction rule passes

static_input_facts_not_counted_as_probe_.candidate_active_path: user embedding plus softmax-weighted training-history item summary; pairwise BPR loss plus 0.1 times leave-one-support-out squared margin penalty
static_input_facts_not_counted_as_probe_.candidate_off_path: candidate-owned direct BPR dot-product predict/full-sort/pairwise loss
static_input_facts_not_counted_as_probe_.q2_recheck_requirement: Q1 BPR equivalence is input evidence only; Q2 must compare the off path with the declared LIGHTGCN__LGCN_DUAL_PATH parent on real data
